name: Suspicious File Download From File Sharing Domain Via Wget.EXE
description: Detects potentially suspicious file downloads from file sharing domains using wget.exe
author: GAI_CTI
query: (process.executable:*\\wget.exe OR process.pe.original_file_name:wget.exe) AND (process.command_line:(*.githubusercontent.com* OR *anonfiles.com* OR *cdn.discordapp.com* OR *ddns.net* OR *dl.dropboxusercontent.com* OR *ghostbin.co* OR *glitch.me* OR *gofile.io* OR *hastebin.com* OR *mediafire.com* OR *mega.nz* OR *onrender.com* OR *pages.dev* OR *paste.ee* OR *pastebin.com* OR *pastebin.pl* OR *pastetext.net* OR *pixeldrain.com* OR *privatlab.com* OR *privatlab.net* OR *send.exploit.in* OR *sendspace.com* OR *storage.googleapis.com* OR *storjshare.io* OR *supabase.co* OR *temp.sh* OR *transfer.sh* OR *trycloudflare.com* OR *ufile.io* OR *w3spaces.com* OR *workers.dev*)) AND process.command_line:*http* AND (process.command_line:/\s-O\s/ OR process.command_line:*\-\-output\-document*) AND (process.command_line:(*.ps1 OR *.ps1' OR *.ps1\" OR *.dat OR *.dat' OR *.dat\" OR *.msi OR *.msi' OR *.msi\" OR *.bat OR *.bat' OR *.bat\" OR *.exe OR *.exe' OR *.exe\" OR *.vbs OR *.vbs' OR *.vbs\" OR *.vbe OR *.vbe' OR *.vbe\" OR *.hta OR *.hta' OR *.hta\" OR *.dll OR *.dll' OR *.dll\" OR *.psm1 OR *.psm1' OR *.psm1\"))
